commands.label: write-lean-claude-desktop-config
commands.note: Write lean config with only desktop-commander, then launch Claude Desktop minimized
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$src='%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json'; $bak='%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config_backup_20261029b.json'; Copy-Item $src $bak -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $lean='{"mcpServers":{"desktop-commander":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","@wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest"]}}}'; $lean|Set-Content $src -Encoding UTF8; Start-Sleep 1; explorer 'shell:appsFolder\AnthropicPBC.Claude_p874v2pg6g7v8!Claude'"
